item.title: Mayor Mamdani faces backlash over threat to raise property taxes
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani presented his first preliminary budget, hoping to first implement a tax on wealthy residents and corporations instead of raising property taxes.

item.title: Westchester's Real Time Crime Center monitoring social media for possible teen takeover events
item.description: Westchester County police say they are monitoring social media for posts promoting potential "takeover" events in local malls, shopping centers and other public spaces.

item.title: JFK Jr. and Carolyn Bessette's NYC date spot featured in new Hulu series sees customer surge
item.description: A New York City restaurant in the East Village is experiencing a resurgence after being featured in FX's 'Love Story' as the first date spot of John F. Kennedy Jr. and Carolyn Bessette's first date spot.

item.title: New Jersey lawmakers concerned surge of AI could increase water, electricity costs
item.description: The surge in artificial intelligence is sparking concerns in New Jersey over how it could impact the cost of electricity for residents.

item.title: 8 of 9 missing skiers found dead; 6 rescued following California avalanche near Lake Tahoe
item.description: It is the deadliest avalanche in the U.S. since 1981, when 11 climbers were killed on Mount Rainier, Washington.

item.title: 14-year-old boy from New Jersey in desperate need of kidney transplant
item.description: Thaddeus Giansanti, 14, was born with kidney disease and has already endured multiple surgeries since infancy, and now his only remaining kidney is failing.

item.title: Michelle Yeoh honored with star on Hollywood Walk of Fame: 'I'm so psyched'
item.description: Oscar-winning actress Michelle Yeoh has been honored with a star on the Hollywood Walk of Fame.

item.title: JetBlue flight returns to Newark Airport shortly after takeoff due to engine failure: officials
item.description: Passengers were safely evacuated after engine failure forced a JetBlue flight to return to Newark Liberty International Airport after takeoff, according to officials.

item.title: Parents of teen bystander killed in Bronx wants harsher penalties for youth violence
item.description: The grieving parents of a 16-year-old who was shot and killed in the Bronx want the system to get tougher on youth violence.

item.title: Schumer proposes federal bill to eliminate statute‑of‑limitations barriers for abuse survivors
item.description: Domestic violence cases have been rising sharply on Long Island in recent years, and Sen. Chuck Schumer says that needs to change.
